versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart J — Gas Turbine Auxiliary Power Unit Installations
versions.text:
(See AMC 25B991)
(a) Main pumps. Each fuel pump required for proper APU operation, or required to meet the fuel system requirements of this subpart (other than those in sub-paragraph (b) of this paragraph), is a main pump. For each main pump, provision must be made to allow the bypass of each positive displacement fuel pump other than a fuel injection pump approved as part of the APU.
(b) Emergency pumps. There must be emergency pumps or another main pump to feed the APU immediately after failure of any main pump (other than a fuel injection pump approved as part of the APU).
